source_snapshot.purpose_facts: Prepare two systems for multi-node NCCL and require NCCL execution without errors and performance matching an NVIDIA benchmark document.
procedure_facts: Edit `/etc/hosts`, create root passwordless SSH, install PMIx/libfabric dependencies and download OpenMPI 5.0.5.
The source stops after extracting OpenMPI; it never builds OpenMPI/NCCL-tests or runs NCCL.
criteria_facts: Multi-node NCCL runs without errors and meets an unspecified NVIDIA performance specification.
source_conflicts: Procedure contains setup only, while criteria require a completed NCCL benchmark.
missing_source_information: Two-node GPU/NIC/fabric topology, NCCL/CUDA/OpenMPI/NCCL-tests versions and build.
Collective, ranks/GPUs, message matrix, iterations, transport/plugin/interface, correctness and bandwidth thresholds.

original_test_intent.statement: Run a two-node NCCL collective-performance test across the designated GPUs and interconnect, prove data correctness and error-free completion, and compare algbw/busbw over an approved message-size matrix with a topology-matched NVIDIA reference.
must_preserve: Two physical SUT nodes and multi-node NCCL.
A real collective benchmark, not setup or SSH reachability.
must_not_infer: One rank or one GPU per node.
Socket versus InfiniBand/RoCE transport, GDR, SHARP/NVLS or thresholds.
That 10 minutes is sufficient without an approved matrix.

v2_review_conclusion.summary: V2 correctly identifies the setup-only source, rejects DeepSeek password/host-key shortcuts and requires complete stack, rank mapping, transport, matrix, logs and reference.
v2_review_conclusion.specific_gap: V2 does not explicitly require NCCL data checking, pin the exact network interface/plugin/fallback behavior, reconcile 30/10-minute planning with the message matrix, or distinguish algbw from topology-normalized busbw.

related_records: Single-node NCCL evidence cannot satisfy inter-node transport or two-node rank mapping.
applicable_history.precedence_application: Missing packages/topology are provider-closable, but the setup-only procedure cannot be called complete.

v3_review_conclusion.summary: Replace the setup fragment with a signed two-node NCCL-tests contract. Execution remains automatable after stack, topology, transport, matrix, correctness, thresholds and privileged-change approvals are supplied.

conditions_present: Two nodes, OpenMPI 5.0.5 intent and NCCL performance goal are identified.
missing: Complete software stack/build, secure access, rank/GPU map, fabric/interface/plugin, message/iteration matrix, correctness and reference/limits.
safe_read_only_work: Inventory GPU UUID/BDF/NVLink/NVSwitch, NIC BDF/GUID/firmware/link, NUMA, routes, MTU/RDMA/GDR capability, installed versions and logs on both nodes.
prohibited_until_resolved: Edit hosts/SSH, install/build, firewall/sysctl/network changes, MPI/NCCL traffic, log clearing or PASS.
closure_evidence: Signed two-node rank-to-GPU/NIC map and isolated path.
Pinned compatible stack and secure launcher.

revision_candidate.test_name: Measure Two-Node NCCL All-Reduce Performance and Correctness
revision_candidate.purpose: Run the approved two-node NCCL all-reduce matrix across the exact GPU and network fabric topology, verify reduction correctness and error-free completion, and compare algbw and topology-normalized busbw with a signed comparable NVIDIA reference.
revision_candidate.applicable_platform_environment: Exactly two named SUT nodes with matched GPU/NIC/NVLink/NVSwitch/PCIe/NUMA topology, pinned NVIDIA driver/CUDA/NCCL, OpenMPI 5.0.5 or approved version, PMIx/libfabric/OFED/plugin and NCCL-tests commit. Ethernet, RoCE and InfiniBand paths are not interchangeable.
revision_candidate.target_scope: Signed ranks per node, GPUs per rank, collective/data type/reduction, in-place/out-of-place modes, message range/factor, warmup/iterations and transport. Attended 30/Machine 10 minutes are planning metadata; the approved matrix defines completion.
revision_candidate.required_inputs: Two node identities; secure SSH/orchestrator; rank/GPU/NIC/NUMA map; stack/build hashes; interface/GID/route/MTU/FEC/RDMA/GDR/plugin/fallback policy; collective/matrix/iterations/check flag; environment variables; numeric algbw/busbw/correctness thresholds and reference; abort/recovery limits; approvals.
revision_candidate.test_command_procedure_intent: Capture both-node topology/health/counters, verify binaries and rank mapping, and start only the approved launcher with explicit hostfile and environment. Run the signed `all_reduce_perf` matrix with correctness checking, full untrimmed stdout and per-rank NCCL logs. Confirm actual interface/plugin/transport and no unintended fallback; collect algbw, busbw and wrong/error fields, counters and health, then remove only approved temporary state.
revision_candidate.preconditions: Dedicated healthy two-node fabric; clocks/link/profile frozen; secure trust and package/network changes approved; peer reachability and ports ready; no competing workload; evidence storage and cleanup tested.
revision_candidate.expected_evidence: Both-node hardware/software/topology maps; artifact hashes/build logs; exact hostfile/rank map/commands/environment; NCCL selected interface/plugin/transport; full per-size in/out-of-place time/algbw/busbw/correctness; per-rank logs; NIC/RDMA/FEC/retry/drop counters; GPU XID/ECC/NVLink telemetry; CPU/NUMA/power/thermal and dmesg/SEL; reference comparison; cleanup/final health.
revision_candidate.acceptance_reference: Signed NVIDIA or platform reference for the same two-node topology, GPU/NIC counts, transport/plugin, NCCL-tests collective/data type/modes/message matrix and versions. Pass requires zero disallowed correctness errors, no unintended fallback/hang, complete matrix and all accepted metrics/health within limits; algbw and busbw are not interchangeable.
revision_candidate.safety_restrictions: Do not use root password injection, disable host-key checking, treat `/etc/hosts` as hostfile, install latest/unpinned code, modify network/sysctl/firewall without approval, guess interfaces/ranks, hide logs with `tail`, kill unrelated jobs, auto-retry hangs or compare unmatched topology.
revision_candidate.human_approval_requirements: Owners approve nodes/fabric, secure trust, package/network changes, matrix/reference and load; human authorizes traffic and judges disposition.
revision_candidate.manual_boundaries: Humans select topology/transport/reference and privileged setup. Agent may execute the frozen launcher, monitor and package evidence.
revision_candidate.recovery_requirements: On hang/error/fallback/link fault, terminate recorded ranks/daemons in order, preserve all logs/counters, restore network/SSH/package state, verify both nodes/GPUs/NICs and require approval before rerun.
revision_candidate.stop_conditions: Stack/topology/rank/transport/matrix/reference/approval missing; wrong interface/plugin/fallback; rank/GPU mismatch; correctness error; hang/timeout; NIC/RDMA/NVLink/XID/ECC/thermal/power/host limit; monitoring loss or failed cleanup.

identified_defects: Source never builds or runs NCCL.
Unsafe root trust/package setup lacks approval.
reason_for_change: Turn a two-node setup fragment into an executable, correctness-aware NCCL contract without assuming transport or topology.

new_technical_evidence.title: NCCL Networking Troubleshooting
new_technical_evidence.supports: NCCL may auto-select unusable interfaces and open network ports; selected interface/path must be verified.

new_technical_evidence.title: NCCL Tests Performance
new_technical_evidence.supports: algbw and busbw have distinct meanings and collective-specific normalization.

new_technical_evidence.title: Source testcase Wistron-Performance GPU-00020-V002
new_technical_evidence.supports: Two-node setup fragment, OpenMPI 5.0.5 and NCCL performance criteria.

removed_ambiguities: Pins rank-to-GPU/NIC and actual transport/fallback evidence.
remaining_blockers: Execution waits for complete two-node handoff and privileged approvals.
objective_improvement_over_v2: V3 adds data correctness, interface/plugin/fallback proof, metric semantics, explicit matrix completion and ordered multi-node recovery.

agent_understanding_result.notes: Contract-only validation was CLEAR. The validator preserved exactly two nodes, the signed rank/GPU/NIC/NUMA map and complete all-reduce matrix; rejected setup-only completion, `/etc/hosts` as hostfile, insecure SSH, unintended transport fallback and algbw/busbw substitution; required correctness, per-rank logs, full iterations, ordered cleanup and separate comparable thresholds. No intrinsic document defect was found. This is not independent-model or DUT validation.
